description: This file defines utility functions for splitting a string into tokens based on spaces and storing them in a linked list. It includes a main function 'split' and helper functions to validate tokens and add them to the list.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A linked list data structure, imported from external module.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a linked list of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is valid (non-empty).
